entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your scrying spells last longer.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast a spell of the scrying subschool.

Benefit(s): Any scrying spell you cast lasts twice as long as normal, as if it were cast as an extended spell with the Extend Spell metamagic feat. Additionally, when you cast a scrying spell with a casting time of 10 minutes or longer, that casting time is halved.
